newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo affiliate Sang-A defaults on debt.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo affiliate Sang-A defaults on debt.

text.p: South Korea's Sang-A Pharmaceutical Co, an affiliate of debt-ridden Hanbo Steel Co, said on Saturday it had defaulted on repayment of 1.4 billion won worth of promissory notes.
Sang-A said in a statement that the company's overdraft facilities with its creditor banks Korea First Bank and Kangwon Bank had also been suspended.
Sang-A applied for court receivership on Wednesday and has been on the Korea Stock Exchange's "watch list" since Friday.
The list is designed to protect investors from possible damage from investing in a company faced with managerial difficulties.
Sang-A shares last traded at 9,020 won, down 780.
